# voipms_ring_group (Data Source)

Reads a ring group by id or `name` (`getRingGroups`). Look up by `name`, then link with `route` — do not paste a raw ring group id into a DID.


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_ring_group" "sales" {
  name = "Sales"
}

output "sales_route" {
  value = data.voipms_ring_group.sales.route
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Ring group id.
- `name` (String) Ring group name.

### Read-Only

- `caller_announcement` (String) Recording code played to the caller.
- `language` (String) Language for system messages.
- `members` (Attributes List) Destinations rung by this group, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `music_on_hold` (String) Music on hold class.
- `route` (String) DID routing value (`grp:{id}`). Use this for `voipms_did` `routing` / failover.
- `voicemail` (String) Mailbox that takes the call when nobody answers.

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `press1` (Boolean) Member must press 1 to connect.
- `ring_time` (Number) Seconds this member rings.
- `route` (String) Member route (`account:` or `fwd:`).
